plan.title: Material PR to Auction Award and PO

steps.note: Give the event a title so it can be tracked through conversion and history.
Commit the 30-minute RFQ schedule.
Invite the two vendors named in the case.
Publish the RFQ so both vendors can quote.
Verify that the RFQ reached a published project page.
Submit Vendor A's RFQ quote of 100.
Verify that Vendor A's quote was accepted by the vendor portal.
Submit Vendor B's RFQ quote of 90.
Verify that Vendor B's quote was accepted by the vendor portal.
Wait for the RFQ bidding window to close before conversion.
Convert the published RFQ into the auction round while retaining its quotes and participants.
Verify that the converted auction create screen opened without an error.
Commit the converted auction's bidding schedule.
Publish the converted auction.
Verify that the auction reached a published project page.
Submit Vendor A's auction bid of 85.
Verify that Vendor A's auction bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's auction bid of 88.
Verify that Vendor B's auction bid was accepted.
Wait for the auction bidding window to close before awarding.
Open the comparison grid containing both auction bidders.
Verify that the lower auction amount ranks first.
Verify that Vendor A's awarded total is 10 units multiplied by the bid of 85.
Award all available line items to the L1 vendor, Vendor A, and submit the proposal.
Verify that the award proposal was created and submitted.

args.remark: Approved for Vendor A at the lowest evaluated auction price.

steps.note: Approve the submitted award with the required remark.
Complete the approved award flow and generate the purchase order.
Verify that the PO contains the single PR line with the required quantity of 10.
Return to the events list to verify the completed event's history placement.
Open the History tab after PO creation.
Verify that the plan's event appears in event history.
